records.context: Complete clean exchange read before older-English comparison. Camille notices Lil's quiet mood; the player can admit moral doubts or deflect with banter. Both branches retain his care and her thanks. Lil initially teases Camille that her melancholy expression made his heart skip; he objects that he was worried. His awkward joke about her never worrying lands badly. The admission branch asks whether punishing wrongdoing companies is right when their families suffer. Camille reassures her but hesitates over the harm to families. She says talking helped and sends him back to his work. He offers a rumor about a legendary staff that guides its bearer toward good, knows only that it is around India, and earns her skeptical but grateful interest. The denial branch lets Lil boast that a woman of the sea cannot mope, tease that worrying is Camille's job and the crew would leave if they were both gloomy, then thank him for his concern. A source FE stat notice raises FI's 精神 by1 on that branch. Source storage order includes alternative paths,not one combined conversation.
